Requirements / priorities captured during discovery:
- Workloads: live driver chat (low tail latency), embeddings for manifest/search, reranking for routing suggestions.
- Latency/throughput: aim 50-150ms p99 for chat path, throughput 1000–2000 concurrent inference units during peak shifts; burst tolerance required.
- Model preferences: open-model compatibility; preference for 7B–13B production quantized or specialized reranker model. Needs fallback routing to cheaper model variant.
- Operations: strong telemetry (per-route token cost, latency breakdown), canary rollouts for model changes, retention/archival controls for PII.
- Security: VPC/private control plane mandatory; on-prem option for air-gapped client in Europe; KMS + HSM preferred; SOC2 + audit logging required; EU data residency for EU customers.

- Champion: Head of Platform (was engaged) — now rotated to new role (internal churn). No clear replacement identified; product manager interest but limited clout for procurement.
- Pull: Eng team liked Optimize recommendations demo. Security team explicitly requested HSM + proof of SOC2 controls — escalated to Redwood security on 2025-08-20 (ticket SEC-2109).
- Pain: Current vendor (internal hosting + managed GP endpoint) has unpredictable costs and poor latency for multi-region routing. CTO commented: "We cannot tolerate 300ms tail spikes during peak dispatch."

Why stalled: Multiple reasons stack — company-wide hiring/budget freeze announced 2025-11; CTO put procurement on hold pending Q1 budget review. The old champion moved teams. Security review flagged KMS/HSM gap and asked for vendor attestations; procurement said competing vendor offered deferred-commit financing.
